required_follow_up_case_families.reason: Required baseline sanity check with simple normal-incidence real tensors and zero/nonzero SHG.
Required to catch ordinary/extraordinary recognition and nonlinear-polarization branch swaps.
Required extreme case for singular or near-singular inhomogeneous-field behavior.
Required to validate branch identity without forcing ordinary/extraordinary labels where not physical.

notes: This is a request/contract for Mathematica export, not exported Mathematica data.
The requested symbols come from SHAARP.si front-end text symbol audits and numerical stage snippets.
Each exported case must preserve exact SHAARP.si symbol meanings and include enough metadata to map symbols to Python stage outputs.
Agreement requires value-by-value comparison after Mathematica exports are produced.
